correctness.rationale: Exact 24 vertices V=±e_i and 16 half-sign vectors are unit and antipodal. Pair Gram multiset from independent exact-rational enumeration: inner products -1:12, -1/2:96, 0:72, +1/2:96. For s>=sqrt(2/3), two caps can intersect only if v.z=1/2 (since 2s<=sqrt(2+2 v.z)); three such caps cannot overlap in positive surface measure since 3s<=sqrt(6), equality only lower endpoint. Hence measure inclusion-exclusion exactly 24 single caps minus 96 adjacent double caps. Haar marginal density on S^3 is 2 sqrt(1-t^2)/pi and an orthonormal coordinate pair is uniform on the unit disk, giving P and elementary disk-segment Q. Independent exact Gram enumeration and numerical value at s=sqrt(2/3) 0.9363568184518474 confirm normalization. Expanding y(s)=2 delta+O(delta²) and Q(s0-delta)=4 delta²/(pi sqrt3)+O(delta³) at s0=sqrt3/2 yields the claimed coefficient. The simulation code was inspected but not used to prove the continuum identity.
